# PoultryTrading

> Software and business directory platform for the poultry industry in India. Separate software for poultry traders, retailers and farmers, plus a poultry industry directory. Site: https://poultrytrading.com/

## Products

- Poultry Trader Flow: accounting software for poultry traders.
- Poultry Retailer Flow: shop management and accounting software for poultry retailers.
- Poultry Farmer Flow: farm management and accounting software for poultry farmers.
- Poultry Industry Directory: B2B directory of poultry businesses in India.

## Main page

- [PoultryTrading home](https://poultrytrading.com/): overview of all products and the directory.
